_doc: Marksman line (spec #360, ticket MS2 #362): the skill definitions of the Marksman (322), empty until the skill tickets land. Each ticket appends its own region (a repeated key across files is a load error): MS5 #365 iron_arrow (moved here from skills/bowman.json), strafe_crossbow, dragons_breath_crossbow; MS6 #366 blizzard_crossbow, arrow_eruption; MS7 #367 piercing_arrow; MS8 #368 snipe; MS9 #369 golden_eagle, frostprey. arrow_blow is Bowmaster's shared definition in skills/bowmaster.json and is not redefined here.

golden_eagle._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #360 bonuses (Crossbow Mastery damage, Eagle Eyes area, Second Eagle +1 follower); repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.49.
golden_eagle.name: Golden Eagle
golden_eagle.desc: Calls an eagle that follows you and strikes a monster, which it may stun.
golden_eagle._provenance: Tier A: pad 32..100, prop 59..99%, time 112..180 s, one monster in a +-200 x +-150 box, attackAfter 100 ms, summon/hit art and the Use/Summon sounds. Tier C: 30 s recast, fly follow settings, hover 20, 1.6 s attack cycle, 1.5 s stun, settle (the Silver Hawk's values); GAME_DESIGN 7.49.

frostprey._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #360 bonuses (Marksman Boost damage, Cold Wings a fifth target, Second Frostprey +1 follower); repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 7.49.
frostprey.name: Frostprey
frostprey.desc: Calls a frostprey that follows you and strikes up to four monsters at a time with ice.
frostprey._provenance: Tier A: elemAttr i, pad 270..500 at the mapped levels, time 122..200 s, up to 4 monsters in a +-100 x +-60 box, attackAfter 1440 ms, hit art and the Use/Summon sounds. Tier C: 40 s recast, fly follow settings, hover 20, 3.0 s attack cycle, settle (the Phoenix's values). Balance flag: pad is 3-6 times an arrow's W.Att; GAME_DESIGN 7.49.
